name: Usage Watch
tagline: Tracks what your AI tooling costs and flags the expensive habits
description: Pulls figures for what Grok Bot and Cursor are costing you straight from their interfaces, holds the total against a ceiling you set for the day, and lists whatever is eating most of it. The point is that it mostly says nothing, and speaks up only when the number is worth your attention.
author: compileinstyle
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
